bubble_exempt_mode.note: Renamed, and now a mode name instead of a number.

dialogue_mode.note: Now a mode name: Godot can't load the number 1.1.3 stored, so the engine falls back to `"Box"` until you set it again.

text_to_speech.note: Now a TTS mode name: Godot can't load the number 1.1.3 stored, so the engine falls back to `"Off"` until you set it again.

tts_advanced_fallback.note: Now a TTS mode name: Godot can't load the number 1.1.3 stored, so the engine falls back to `"Simple"` until you set it again.

media_players_locations.note: Renamed. Its `"Voice"` entry moved to `ui_elements_paths["voice_player_path"]`, and `"PEffect"` is gone (the dialogue box's `portrait_effect_player`). An entry may now be `[path, false]`: named, not owned.

ui_elements_paths.note: `"portrait_path"` is gone (the portrait is part of the dialogue box), `"chat_path"` must point at a Chat_Channel, and `"voice_player_path"` is new: the Voice mode's player (1.1.3's `media_players_locations["Voice"]`).

dialogue_suspended.note: No longer a setting. A scene that stored `true` still sets it when loaded, and 1.2 then refuses to start a dialogue: delete the line from the scene.

default_voice_extension.note: Now inherits `Candy_Properties.gd`'s default extension (the same value), unless set.

chat_show_speaker.note: Only matters for chats, which are rebuilt in 1.2.

vn_mode.note: 1.1.3 skipped every VN command (`VN_Bust`, `VN_Scene`...) while it was off, as it was by default. 1.2 turns it on by default, so the VN lines your dialogues hold now run. Set it to `false` to keep 1.1.3's behaviour.

behaviour: Values in dialogues are no longer trimmed: a space around a name or a file name is part of it.
A text variable that can't be resolved shows as written, instead of nothing.
Barks display their text (1.1.3 never showed it).
Each engine only clears the bubbles it wrote last. 1.1.3 cleared every actor's bubble on each Bubbles line and at the end of every dialogue.
The `Wait` command pauses while the dialogue is suspended (1.1.3 kept counting).
A media file that isn't found may play the folder's `Default` file instead of failing.
A finished background or bust playback stays on its last frame (1.1.3 rewound animated sprites and blanked videos).
Which actor is on which bust belongs to the bust scene, shared by every engine using it: another engine can move or remove an actor the first one placed.
A disabled choice's `Setup` runs when `Choice_Status` enables it, not when the menu opens.
Actor names are translated each time they're displayed (through `display_names`), not by the Name command.
